import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a figure with two subplots
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 7))

# Main title for the entire figure
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis: The Influence of Class, Age, and Sex', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Survival Rate by Class and Sex ---
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    y='survived',
    hue='sex',
    order=['First', 'Second', 'Third'],
    ci=None,
    ax=ax1,
    palette={'male': 'skyblue', 'female': 'salmon'}
)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax1.legend(title='Sex')

# Add percentage labels to the bars
for p in ax1.patches:
    ax1.annotate(f'{p.get_height():.0%}',
                 (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                 ha='center', va='center',
                 xytext=(0, 9),
                 textcoords='offset points',
                 fontsize=10,
                 color='black')

# --- Plot 2: Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors ---
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x='age',
    hue='alive',
    fill=True,
    common_norm=False,
    ax=ax2,
    palette={'no': 'gray', 'yes': 'green'},
    alpha=0.6
)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(title='Survived', labels=['Yes', 'No'])

# Improve layout to prevent titles/labels from overlapping
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
